2609.26314.title: TriWorldBench: A Tri-View Consistency Perspective on Embodied World Models
2609.26314.paper_summary: Embodied world models predict the outcomes of robot actions to support learning and planning. For robots equipped with head and wrist cameras, this requires complementary views: the head view captures the overall task, while wrist views reveal local gripper-object interactions. However, evaluating these views independently cannot determine whether they describe the same action and object state. We introduce TRIWORLDBENCH, a benchmark for evaluating embodied world models through synchronized head, left-wrist, and right-wrist videos. It contains 500 episodes across 50 bimanual manipulation tasks and uses 19 metrics to assess tri-view consistency, task alignment, physical and 3D coherence, motion quality, temporal consistency, and visual quality. By combining cross-view checks with measurements tailored to each camera, the benchmark evaluates whether plausible individual videos also form a consistent prediction of the intended task. We summarize overall performance with TWB-Score and retain per-view results to identify where predictions fail. This extends world-model evaluation beyond single-view visual quality. Code, data, and metric definitions are available at https://github.com/TriWorldBench/TriWorldBench.
2609.26314.paper_summary_zh: 具身世界模型預測機器人行動的結果，以支持學習和規劃。對於配備頭部和手腕攝影機的機器人，這需要互補的視角：頭部視角捕捉整體任務，而手腕視角則揭示局部的夾具與物體互動。然而，獨立評估這些視角無法確定它們是否描述相同的行動和物體狀態。我們介紹了TRIWORLDBENCH，這是一個通過同步的頭部、左手腕和右手腕視頻來評估具身世界模型的基準。它包含500個集數，涵蓋50個雙手操作任務，並使用19個指標來評估三視角一致性、任務對齊、物理和3D一致性、運動質量、時間一致性和視覺質量。通過將跨視角檢查與針對每個攝影機量身定制的測量相結合，該基準評估可行的個別視頻是否也形成對預期任務的一致預測。我們用TWB-Score總結整體表現，並保留每個視角的結果以識別預測失敗的地方。這擴展了世界模型評估，超越了單一視角的視覺質量。代碼、數據和指標定義可在https://github.com/TriWorldBench/TriWorldBench獲得。
